# FemmaDexDrive

> FemmaDexDrive provides parcel, goods, courier and dispatch services in Lagos and other serviceable locations in Nigeria.

## Public pages

- Home: https://femmadexdrive.netlify.app/
- Customer booking and dashboard: https://femmadexdrive.netlify.app/book
- Public tracking: https://femmadexdrive.netlify.app/track
- Dispatch and failed-delivery terms: https://femmadexdrive.netlify.app/terms

## How booking works

Customers sign in or create an account, select pickup and destination locations, describe the goods and recipient, and request a route-based quote. FemmaDexDrive Operations verifies the vehicle and approves the final price. Customers then pay through the existing Paystack checkout. Rider matching and delivery updates follow payment confirmation.

Prices are calculated from the actual route and order details; there is no single public flat rate. An approved customer quote is shown before checkout. Do not represent a quote request as a confirmed booking or payment.

## Failed delivery

If a sender is unavailable at pickup, Operations may cancel the dispatch without automatically changing the payment record. If a recipient is unavailable after goods have been collected, Operations may arrange return to sender. A requested redelivery is charged at 45% of the original dispatch price as the total redelivery charge. Goods reported ready for collection are held for three working days after customer notification; further handling is subject to applicable law.

These are proposed customer terms and should receive legal review in the applicable jurisdiction. The website is a web booking experience and does not claim to provide a native Siri integration.

## Contact and safety

Customer and rider contact details are disclosed through the authenticated dashboard only. Public tracking is limited and does not expose exact live GPS locations.
